description: The plot illustrates how AUC performance (in percent) varies with the parameter \(N\) for five different methods/series shown as colored lines with distinct markers. The x-axis is labeled “N” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 20, with visible tick labels at 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 75 to 100, with tick labels at 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100. A blue solid line with open circle markers starts near 95 at \(N\approx 1\), rises to about 98 at \(N\approx 4\), reaches about 99 at \(N\approx 10\), and stays near 99–100 through \(N\approx 15\) and \(N\approx 20\). A red solid line with open square markers begins around 88 at \(N\approx 1\), increases to about 95 at \(N\approx 4\), peaks near 99 at \(N\approx 10\), then dips slightly to about 98 at \(N\approx 15\) and ends around 98–99 at \(N\approx 20\). An orange solid line with open diamond markers starts near 85 at \(N\approx 1\), rises to about 96 at \(N\approx 4\), increases to about 97–98 at \(N\approx 10\), continues upward to about 99 at \(N\approx 15\), and ends near 100 at \(N\approx 20\). A green solid line with star markers begins around 87 at \(N\approx 1\), increases to about 94 at \(N\approx 4\), reaches about 96–97 at \(N\approx 10\), rises to about 98–99 at \(N\approx 15\), and ends around 99 at \(N\approx 20\). A purple solid line with left-pointing triangle markers starts near 80 at \(N\approx 1\), increases slightly to about 81 at \(N\approx 5\), jumps sharply to about 98 at \(N\approx 10\), then drops to about 94 at \(N\approx 15\) and remains around 94 at \(N\approx 20\).
